title: Fur Friends ⚔️ Battle Edition Day 28 | The Sneaky Market | Cozy Kawaii RPG Animation & Lofi
description:
Someone keeps stealing snacks at the market! The thief is Snek the Rogue, a raccoon who was collecting food for hungry slimes. Snek joins the party, they calm the Greedy Mimic chest, and share a big market picnic.

0:00 The Missing Snacks
0:45 Snek the Rogue
1:30 The Greedy Mimic
2:15 Market Picnic

⚔️ Fur Friends: Battle Edition — the Fur Friends are adventuring in Pawlandia Online, a cozy fantasy MMORPG world. A new friend joins every episode!
🐾 No one gets hurt: bonked monsters just get dizzy, then become friends.
🎧 Best with headphones. Original lofi music & cozy fantasy sounds.
